## Profile

I am a marketing data scientist focused on understanding and improving marketing
performance through experiments, customer analytics, and statistical modelling. I care
about analysis that is reproducible, easy to scrutinise, and useful in real decisions.

My academic background in psychology helps me ask better questions about behaviour,
measurement, and decision-making. It complements the data science work without replacing
its practical marketing focus.

## What I work on

- Designing and evaluating marketing experiments.
- Understanding campaign performance beyond surface-level attribution.
- Analysing customer segments, journeys, and response patterns.
- Building transparent Python and SQL workflows for repeatable analysis.
- Turning statistical output into recommendations that non-technical teams can use.

## How I approach analysis

Start with the decision, make assumptions visible, and use the simplest method that can
answer the question credibly. A useful analysis should explain not only what happened,
but also what the team should learn or do next.

## Tools and methods

Python, pandas, scikit-learn, SQL, Quarto, Git, experimentation, campaign analytics,
segmentation, forecasting, data visualisation, and stakeholder communication.
